def factor_asym_vol_40(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    down_ret = ret.clip(upper=0)
    up_ret = ret.clip(lower=0)
    down_var = (down_ret ** 2).ewm(span=40, min_periods=40).mean()
    up_var = (up_ret ** 2).ewm(span=40, min_periods=40).mean()
    down_vol = np.sqrt(down_var.clip(lower=0))
    up_vol = np.sqrt(up_var.clip(lower=0))
    signal = down_vol - up_vol
    df_copy["factor_asym_vol_40"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_asym_vol_40"]
